# Results (synthetic)

The association was strong, χ2(1) = 1,024.3, P < .001.

Across all groups the difference was large, F(2, 4000) = 1,234.56, P < .001.

The variance ratio was F(1, 10) = 1e5, P = .04.

The rank effect was t(48) = 2.10, P < 0,001.

The pooled comparison gave t(20000000) = 2.10, P = .04.
